_about: The storyteller's incident cards. Each is pitched with reasons from the world and only happens when the DM accepts it. drama 1 (small) to 5 (huge). when: conditions, as in story.json (plus festival: a festival within 12 days; follows: tags of a recent chronicle entry at the place; rankMin/rankMax: the party's rank; standingBelow/Above: the party's standing in the place; renownAbove: renown in its region; factionBelow/Above: the party's worst or best standing with a faction, which becomes {faction}; shortage: the place is short of something, which becomes {goods}). cast: the people it needs (role is an NPC generator role). effects: change to the place's numbers. trouble: starts a regional trouble. newPlace: 'site' or 'settlement' makes a new place nearby. scenes: the quest's scenes (default: scenes[kind]). Tokens: {place}, {lead}, {second}, {third}, {goods}, {church}, {trouble}, {festival}, {faction}, {monster}, {newplace}, {rank}.
rewardByDrama: 1,000 spirit coins and a debt of honour
A fortune in spirit coins, and the gratitude of a region
factions: a noble family from the capital

disaster: See the damage for yourselves, and help where help is needed most.
Find out what really caused it.
Deal with the cause, before it happens again.
society: Meet the people involved, each with their own story.
Bring it to a head, and live with the consequences.
faction: Find out who is behind it, and what they want.
Confront the faction's agent, by deal, by law or by force.
economy: Follow the money, or the missing goods.
Put things right, or make a deal.
monster: Gather what's known: sightings, survivors and tracks.
Track it to where it hunts or lairs.
Fight it on ground of your choosing, if you can.
personal: Find the truth behind what they asked.
Choose a side, and see it through.
magic: Find someone who understands it, or the place it comes from.

cards.name: A district burns
cards.text: Fire swept through the poorest quarter of {place} overnight. Dozens are homeless, and the {church} has opened its doors to them.
cards.dm: It was set. {lead} paid a street gang to clear the land for a warehouse, and two people died in the blaze.
cards.goal: Find out who started the fire, and decide what to do about it.
cards.rumour: People in {place} are saying the fire was no accident.

cards.name: The granary burns
cards.text: The main granary in {place} burned to the ground, and the winter stores with it.
cards.dm: A monster core stored in the cellar by {lead} cracked and caught. They are hiding what happened.
cards.goal: Bring in food before the winter, or find who is to blame.

cards.name: The river breaks its banks
cards.text: Days of rain have sent the river over its banks at {place}. Low streets are underwater and families are trapped on rooftops.
cards.dm: Something in the flood is hunting the stranded: {monster}, washed down from upstream.
cards.goal: Help with the rescue, and deal with what came down with the water.
scenes: Boats and ropes: pull families off the rooftops while the water keeps rising.
Bodies in the water have bite marks. Track the thing that is hunting the stranded.
Fight it in the flooded streets, where footing is bad and the current is strong.
The water falls back. The town counts its losses, and remembers who helped.

cards.name: The old dam cracks
cards.text: Engineers say the old dam above {place} is cracking, and could fail within the tenday. The town council can't agree whether to evacuate.
cards.dm: {lead} has been quarrying stone from the dam's base for years and selling it on. Sealing the crack needs earth magic, or a lot of hands and a brave plan.
cards.goal: Save {place} from the flood, by repairing the dam or getting everyone out in time.

cards.name: A spreading sickness
cards.text: A wasting cough is spreading through {place}. The {church} cannot heal it fast enough, and neighbours are sealing their doors.
cards.dm: The sickness comes from a cursed relic {lead} brought back from a ruin and sold at market. Every buyer's household fell ill.
cards.goal: Find the source of the sickness before it spreads to the next town.
cards.rumour: Travellers from {place} are being turned away at other towns' gates.

cards.name: Quarantine
cards.text: {place} has been sealed by order of the authorities. No one goes in or out until the sickness burns itself out.
cards.dm: Food is running out inside, and {lead} is smuggling people out through the old drains, sickness and all.
cards.goal: Get a cure, food or a way out to the people inside {place}, without spreading the sickness further.

cards.name: The ground shakes
cards.text: An earthquake shook {place}. Walls fell, a temple tower collapsed, and a crack has opened in the hills nearby.
cards.dm: The crack leads down into an old sealed place, and something in it is awake now.
cards.goal: Help dig out the trapped, then find out what the crack opened.

cards.name: A ship is wrecked
cards.text: A storm drove a merchant ship onto the rocks near {place}. Wreckers are already picking over the cargo.
cards.dm: The ship carried a sealed crate for {faction}. Whoever holds it now is in danger, and doesn't know it.
cards.goal: Recover the crate, or the survivors, before the wreckers or {faction} do.

cards.name: Hail flattens the crops
cards.text: A freak hailstorm flattened the fields around {place} days before harvest.
cards.dm: Storm priests whisper that it was sent. {lead} cursed the town after being thrown out of the council.
cards.goal: Help {place} through a hungry season, or find out if the storm was sent.

cards.name: The road is buried
cards.text: A landslide buried the only road out of {place} and a wagon train with it.
cards.dm: Bandits started it with blasting powder, and are waiting for the clear-up crews.
cards.goal: Dig out the road and the wagons, and deal with whoever is waiting.

cards.name: Wildfire
cards.text: A wildfire is sweeping toward {place} on a hot wind. The town is cutting firebreaks and praying for rain.
cards.dm: The fire has a heart: an elemental born of the summer's magic, feeding as it goes.
cards.goal: Stop the fire before it reaches {place}.

cards.name: The wells run dry
cards.text: The wells in {place} are failing one after another. Water sellers are charging what they like.
cards.dm: {lead} has dammed the spring upstream to sell the water at their own price.
cards.goal: Get water flowing to {place} again.

cards.name: Snowed in
cards.text: A blizzard has cut {place} off. Supplies are running low and a caravan is lost somewhere on the road.
cards.dm: The caravan carried {lead}, who is carrying something worth a great deal to {faction}.
cards.goal: Find the lost caravan in the snow.

cards.name: The mine collapses
cards.text: A mine near {place} has collapsed with forty workers inside. Tapping can still be heard from below.
cards.dm: The miners broke into a cavern full of spawned monsters, and the collapse was the only thing holding them back.
cards.goal: Get the miners out alive.
scenes: Organise the rescue: digging, shoring timbers, and families crowding the entrance.
Below ground, the survivors are not alone. Something is digging toward them too.
Bring the miners up, and seal or clear what they found.

cards.name: The magic thickens
cards.text: The magic around {place} is running thick. Spawns come more often and stronger, and old-timers have started counting.
cards.dm: A surge is building. If it isn't eased, it will peak within two months with something far stronger than {rank} rank.
cards.goal: Warn the Adventure Society, and find a way to ease the build before it peaks.

trouble.name: A surge building
trouble.summary: The magic is thickening and spawns are coming faster.
trouble.effect: Expect more and stronger monsters on every road.

cards.rumour: The Society's instruments around {place} are disagreeing with the calendar.

cards.name: The surge peaks
cards.text: The surge around {place} has peaked. The region is spawning more than it can kill, villages are evacuating, and every licensed adventurer is called up.
cards.dm: At the heart of it stands {monster}, carrying the region's gathered magic. Killing it ends the surge.
cards.goal: Hold the line, and kill what the surge has built.
scenes: The call-up: every team is given a sector, and refusing is misconduct.
Hold a village while its people get away, against wave after wave.
Track the surge's heart through ground thick with monsters.
Fight the peak creature. If it lives, the region bleeds for months.

cards.name: The street falls in
cards.text: A sinkhole opened in the middle of {place}, swallowing two houses. Old stonework can be seen far below.
cards.dm: It has opened into tunnels used by smugglers, and they want it filled fast, with or without the families who fell.
cards.goal: Rescue the fallen, and find out what is down there.

cards.name: A swarm
cards.text: A swarm of giant insects is stripping the fields around {place}, and it is moving toward the next valley.
cards.dm: The swarm is guarded by its queen, spawned in a hollow hill nearby.
cards.goal: Find and destroy the swarm's queen.

cards.name: The bridge falls
cards.text: The great bridge at {place} collapsed, cutting the trade road in two. Ferrymen are getting rich.
cards.dm: The ferrymen's guild, led by {lead}, weakened the bridge's piers.
cards.goal: Get the road open again, and prove who brought the bridge down.

cards.name: A poisoned well
cards.text: Half of {place} fell sick after drinking from the town well. Three have died.
cards.dm: {lead} poisoned it to drive families off land that {faction} wants to buy cheap.
cards.goal: Find the poisoner.

cards.name: The killing frost
cards.text: A killing frost has gripped {place}. Firewood has run out, and the poorest are freezing in their homes.
cards.dm: A frost spirit took up residence in the old mill when its shrine was torn down.
cards.goal: Help {place} through the cold, and find what is making it.

cards.name: A wedding between rivals
cards.text: {lead} and {second}, from two families who have feuded for a generation, are to marry in {place}. Half the town expects bloodshed at the feast.
cards.dm: An uncle on one side means to poison the wedding cup and blame the other family.
cards.goal: Keep the peace at the wedding.
scenes: Meet both families, each sure the other means harm.
The feast: music, toasts, and a cup that must not be drunk.
Unmask the poisoner before the families turn on each other.
cards.reward: A place of honour at both families' tables, and a purse from each

cards.name: A feud turns bloody
cards.text: The quarrel between {lead} and {second} in {place} has turned bloody: a barn burned and a son beaten half to death.
cards.dm: Neither family did it. {third} is stoking the feud to buy both farms cheap when they ruin each other.
cards.goal: End the feud before someone dies.

cards.name: A disputed inheritance
cards.text: Old {lead} has died, and two claimants want the estate outside {place}: the eldest child and a stranger with a will that names them.
cards.dm: The will is real. The stranger is a child born outside the marriage, and the eldest knows it and has hired killers.
cards.goal: Settle the inheritance, one way or another.

cards.name: Death at the festival
cards.text: At {festival} in {place}, a well-known figure collapsed and died in front of a crowd.
cards.dm: {lead} was poisoned by someone in a mask. The masks make everyone a suspect, and the killer means to strike again before the festival ends.
cards.goal: Find the killer before the festival ends.
scenes: The death in the crowd, and who was close enough.
Questioning masked revellers who have every reason to lie.
A second attempt, and a chase through the festival.
Unmask the killer.

cards.name: The festival prize is stolen
cards.text: The prize for {festival} in {place} has been stolen days before it is due to be awarded.
cards.dm: {lead} took it to pay off a debt, and is desperate to put it back before anyone notices.
cards.goal: Find the prize before {festival}.

cards.name: A bread riot
cards.text: Prices in {place} have pushed people too far. A crowd broke into the grain merchants' warehouses, and the guard has been called out.
cards.dm: {lead} is hoarding grain to drive the price up, and {second} is egging the crowd on for reasons of their own.
cards.goal: Stop the riot from becoming a massacre.

cards.name: A ring of thieves
cards.text: Burglaries in {place} are coming every night, always at the houses of the well-off, always without a sound.
cards.dm: The thieves are children trained by {lead}, who uses a sound-dampening essence ability.
cards.goal: Catch the thieves.

cards.name: A kidnapping
cards.text: The child of {lead} has been taken from their home in {place}. A ransom note asks for more than the family can pay.
cards.dm: The kidnapper is a former servant, {second}, who believes the child is their own.
cards.goal: Bring the child home.

cards.name: A team goes missing
cards.text: An Iron-rank team from {place} took a contract two weeks ago and hasn't come back.
cards.dm: They found something they shouldn't have, and {lead} of the local Society office buried their report.
cards.goal: Find out what happened to the missing team.

cards.name: A priest's scandal
cards.text: A priest of the {church} in {place} has been accused of stealing from the temple poor box.
cards.dm: The accusation is true, but {lead} stole to pay a blackmailer who knows a far worse secret.
cards.goal: Find out what is really going on.

cards.name: A challenge to a duel
cards.text: {lead} has challenged {second} to a duel in {place} over an insult at a dinner. The town has taken sides.
cards.dm: {second} is a far better fighter and has been hired to provoke the duel and kill {lead}.
cards.goal: Stop the duel, or make it fair.

cards.name: A trial
cards.text: {lead} is on trial in {place} for a murder they swear they didn't commit, and the judge seems to have already decided.
cards.dm: The real killer is the judge's own relative.
cards.goal: Find the truth before sentence is passed.

cards.name: Refugees arrive
cards.text: A column of refugees has arrived at {place}, driven from their villages by {trouble}. The town is divided over letting them in.
cards.dm: Among them is {lead}, who is not a refugee at all.
cards.goal: Help {place} decide what to do, and find out who is hiding in the column.

cards.name: A council election
cards.text: {place} is choosing a new head of its council, and the vote is close between {lead} and {second}.
cards.dm: {second} is buying votes, and {lead} is being blackmailed.
cards.goal: Make sure the vote is honest, or decide whose side to take.

cards.name: Signs of a cult
cards.text: Strange symbols are appearing on doors in {place}, and people who ask about them go quiet.
cards.dm: A cult has taken root, led by {lead}, who is well liked and above suspicion.
cards.goal: Find the cult before it acts.

cards.name: A cult's ritual
cards.text: People have been vanishing from {place}, always on nights without a moon.
cards.dm: The cult led by {lead} is gathering sacrifices for a ritual on the next moonless night.
cards.goal: Stop the ritual.
scenes: Follow the trail of the vanished.
Find the cult's meeting place, and who in town protects it.
Break up the ritual before it is finished.

cards.name: A strike
cards.text: The workers of {place}'s biggest workshop have put down their tools over unpaid wages.
cards.dm: {lead} owes {faction} a fortune and is about to vanish with the payroll.
cards.goal: Settle the strike, or stop the owner from running.

cards.name: A haunted house
cards.text: A family in {place} has fled their house, swearing that the dead walk in it.
cards.dm: It isn't the dead. {lead} is scaring them off to get at something buried under the floor.
cards.goal: Clear the house, or catch the haunter.

cards.name: A bounty
cards.text: A bounty has been posted in {place} for {lead}, a killer who escaped the gallows.
cards.dm: {lead} was framed, and the bounty was posted by the person who framed them.
cards.goal: Bring in the fugitive, or find out why they ran.

cards.name: An old friend in trouble
cards.text: {lead}, an old acquaintance of the party, sends word from {place}: they need help, and can't say why in a letter.
cards.dm: {lead} has fallen in with dangerous people and owes them a favour that involves the party.
cards.goal: Answer the letter.

cards.name: A tavern war
cards.text: Two taverns in {place} are at war over the town's custom: brawls, poisoned ale and a bard bought off.
cards.dm: {lead} of one tavern is sweet on the owner of the other, and the war is their families' doing.
cards.goal: End the tavern war.

cards.name: A house takes the council
cards.text: {faction} has bought up the debts of half the council of {place}, and the next vote will go their way.
cards.dm: {faction} wants the town's water rights. {lead}, the one councillor they can't buy, has started receiving threats.
cards.goal: Protect the honest councillor, or decide which side to back.

cards.name: A church opens a shrine
cards.text: The {church} is opening a new shrine in {place}, and not everyone is pleased.
cards.dm: A rival church has paid {lead} to make sure the opening goes badly.
cards.goal: Keep the opening peaceful.

cards.name: Churches at odds
cards.text: Preachers of two churches are shouting each other down in the market at {place}, and their followers have started throwing stones.
cards.dm: {lead} is a provocateur working for neither church, hired to make both look bad.
cards.goal: Calm things down before a riot, and find who is stirring it.

cards.name: An alliance by marriage
cards.text: {faction} and another great house have announced an alliance in {place}, sealed by marriage.
cards.dm: The bride, {lead}, plans to run away on the night before the wedding, and asks the party for help.
cards.goal: Help the runaway, or see the alliance through.

cards.name: A church splits
cards.text: The {church} in {place} has split over a new preacher, {lead}, who claims the god speaks to them directly.
cards.dm: The god does. {lead} carries a divine essence, and the church's elders would rather they were dead than proved right.
cards.goal: Protect the preacher, or the church's unity.

cards.name: A spy in the house
cards.text: {lead} of {faction} believes someone in their household is selling secrets, and wants the party to find them quietly.
cards.dm: The spy is {lead}'s own heir, selling secrets to pay a gambling debt.
cards.goal: Find the spy.

cards.name: A guild war
cards.text: Two crafting guilds in {place} are at war: workshops burned, apprentices beaten, and a master found dead.
cards.dm: {faction} is arming both sides, to take over whichever is left.
cards.goal: End the guild war.

cards.name: Who controls the road
cards.text: {faction} has put armed men on the trade road near {place} and is charging every wagon a toll.
cards.dm: The tolls are a test. If no one stops them, {faction} means to take the town next.
cards.goal: Get the road open, by law, by force or by deal.

cards.name: The Society and the town
cards.text: The Adventure Society branch near {place} and the local lord are at odds over who pays for monster clearance.
cards.dm: {lead} of the Society branch has been taking money from both sides.
cards.goal: Settle who pays, and expose the double-dealer.

cards.name: The Magic Society's experiment
cards.text: The Magic Society has set up instruments outside {place}, and since then the animals have been acting strangely.
cards.dm: {lead} is drawing ambient magic from the region into a crystal, which makes spawning worse elsewhere.
cards.goal: Find out what the Magic Society is doing, and whether it should stop.

cards.name: A plot against the ruler
cards.text: Rumours in {place} say the ruler's guards have been replaced, one by one, with strangers.
cards.dm: {lead}, the ruler's trusted advisor, is behind it, backed by {faction}, and means to strike at the next public ceremony.
cards.goal: Stop the coup, or decide whether it should succeed.
scenes: Notice the strangers in the guard, and the one who is afraid.
Follow the plot to the advisor's door.
The ceremony: stop the strike or step aside.

cards.name: A house in debt
cards.text: {faction} has run out of money, and its creditors are circling. Its servants in {place} haven't been paid for months.
cards.dm: {lead}, the house's steward, has been stealing for years and is about to blame the party's patron.
cards.goal: Find where the money went.

cards.name: A cult in the house
cards.text: Members of {faction} in {place} have been seen at night where no one respectable goes.
cards.dm: A cult has taken over the household, starting with {lead}, the house's head.
cards.goal: Find out how deep the cult goes, and break its hold.

cards.name: A bandit claims the hills
cards.text: The bandit {lead} has claimed the hills above {place} as a private domain and demands tribute.
cards.dm: {lead} is a former soldier of {faction}, and still takes their orders.
cards.goal: Deal with the self-made lord.

trouble.name: The bandit lord
trouble.summary: Armed riders demand tribute from every farm and wagon.
trouble.effect: Roads are watched, and travellers are robbed.

cards.name: Two houses at war
cards.text: Two great houses have taken their quarrel to the streets of {place}. Retainers fight at night, and nobody walks alone.
cards.dm: The feud began with a murder that {lead} arranged to make each house blame the other.
cards.goal: End the house war before the city burns.

cards.name: A house recruits adventurers
cards.text: {faction} is hiring adventurers in {place} for a private expedition, with pay far above the Society's rates.
cards.dm: The expedition is to an astral space the Society has forbidden.
cards.goal: Take the job, or find out what it really is.

cards.name: A cartel
cards.text: Every merchant in {place} has raised their price for {goods} on the same day.
cards.dm: {lead} has formed a cartel, and threatens anyone who sells cheap.
cards.goal: Break the cartel.

cards.name: An inquisition
cards.text: Inquisitors of the Church of Purity have come to {place} looking for corruption, and they are not gentle.
cards.dm: They are after {lead}, who carries an unusual essence. The inquisitors' leader has a grudge of their own.
cards.goal: Protect the innocent from the inquisition, or help it find the guilty.

cards.name: An envoy arrives
cards.text: An envoy from a distant realm has arrived in {place}, asking for a meeting with the local ruler.
cards.dm: {lead} the envoy is an assassin with real papers.
cards.goal: Keep the envoy safe, or keep everyone safe from the envoy.

cards.name: A tax revolt
cards.text: The farms around {place} have refused to pay the new taxes, and soldiers are on their way.
cards.dm: The taxes were never ordered. {lead} has been collecting them for personal profit.
cards.goal: Stop the soldiers and the farmers from killing each other.

cards.name: A forbidden church
cards.text: Graves have been opened outside {place}, and the dead were seen walking toward the hills.
cards.dm: An outlawed church has a hidden temple nearby, led by {lead}.
cards.goal: Find the temple and stop what it is doing.

cards.name: A caravan needs guards
cards.text: A caravan of {goods} is leaving {place} and its guards have quit, scared off by talk of the road.
cards.dm: {lead}, the caravan master, is also carrying something they haven't declared.
cards.goal: Escort the caravan safely to the next town.
cards.reward: Escort pay, and a share of the profit

cards.name: Food runs short
cards.text: {place} is running out of food. Bread costs triple, and a food caravan is a week overdue.
cards.dm: The caravan was taken by {lead}'s gang, who are selling the food back to the town at a fortune.
cards.goal: Get food to {place}.

cards.name: A shortage of {goods}
cards.text: {place} has run out of {goods}, and the price is climbing every day.
cards.dm: A supplier upstream, {lead}, is holding back stock to drive the price up.
cards.goal: Find more {goods}, or break the hold-up.

cards.name: A strike in the hills
cards.text: A rich seam has been found near {place}, and prospectors are flooding in.
cards.dm: The seam runs under land {faction} claims, and they are sending people to take it.
cards.goal: Keep the peace between prospectors and {faction}, or stake a claim yourselves.

cards.name: Business is booming
cards.text: {place} is booming. New shops are opening, and merchants from far away are setting up.
cards.dm: One of the newcomers, {lead}, is laundering money for a criminal ring.
cards.goal: Make the most of the boom, or root out the dirty money.

cards.name: Bad coin
cards.text: False spirit coins are turning up in {place}'s markets, and merchants are refusing all coin.
cards.dm: {lead} is minting them with stolen core dust.
cards.goal: Find the counterfeiter.

cards.name: A rigged auction
cards.text: A great auction is coming to {place}, and a famous item is the prize lot.
cards.dm: {lead} has arranged for the lot to be swapped for a fake on the night.
cards.goal: Make sure the right buyer goes home with the real thing.

cards.name: The moneylender's men
cards.text: Debt collectors working for {lead} are beating people in {place} who can't pay.
cards.dm: {lead} is collecting on loans {faction} sold to them, and the papers are forged.
cards.goal: Stop the beatings, and look into the papers.

cards.name: A smuggling ring
cards.text: Goods are coming into {place} without paying tolls, and the town's coffers are hurting.
cards.dm: The smugglers use old tunnels, and {lead} of the town watch is in on it.
cards.goal: Break the smuggling ring.

cards.name: A new market day
cards.text: {place} has been granted a weekly market, and traders from the whole region are coming.
cards.dm: {lead} wants the market for their own town and plans to wreck the first one.
cards.goal: Make sure the first market day goes well.

cards.name: Harvest thieves
cards.text: Someone is stealing from the fields around {place} at night, just as the harvest comes in.
cards.dm: It is hungry refugees, hiding in the woods, led by {lead}.
cards.goal: Catch the thieves, and decide what to do about them.

cards.name: A price war
cards.text: Two merchants in {place} are selling {goods} at a loss to drive each other out.
cards.dm: {lead} is paying for it with money from {faction}, who want the trade once the other is ruined.
cards.goal: Find out who is backing the price war.

cards.name: Monster cores go missing
cards.text: A shipment of monster cores bound for {place} has vanished on the road.
cards.dm: {lead}, the shipping agent, sold the cores to a cultist buyer.
cards.goal: Find the cores.

cards.name: A crafter loses everything
cards.text: {lead}, the best crafter in {place}, has lost their workshop to fire, and with it a commission for {faction}.
cards.dm: The fire was set by a rival who wanted the commission.
cards.goal: Help the crafter finish the commission in time.

cards.name: New tolls
cards.text: The lord of {place} has doubled the road tolls, and trade has slowed to a trickle.
cards.dm: {lead} needs the money to pay off a blackmailer.
cards.goal: Find out why the tolls went up, and get them down.

cards.name: Famine
cards.text: {place} is starving. The harvest failed, the stores are gone, and people are eating seed grain.
cards.dm: Food is only three days away, but {faction} has bought it all, and will sell only for the town's land deeds.
cards.goal: Save {place} from famine.
scenes: See the hunger in {place} for yourselves.
Follow the food to the warehouses of {faction}.
Get the food to the people, by deal, by law or by theft.

cards.name: A cargo lost in the marsh
cards.text: A barge carrying {goods} sank in the marshes near {place}, and the owner offers a reward to recover it.
cards.dm: The barge didn't sink. It was taken by marsh-dwellers who are owed money by the owner.
cards.goal: Recover the cargo.

cards.name: A guild charter
cards.text: The crafters of {place} want a charter to form a guild, and the council wants a favour first.
cards.dm: The favour is to clear a ruin that {lead} has been using to hide stolen goods.
cards.goal: Earn the guild its charter.

cards.name: A run on the moneylenders
cards.text: Word has spread in {place} that the moneylenders are short of coin, and everyone wants their savings back at once.
cards.dm: {lead} started the rumour to buy up the moneylenders' notes for nothing.
cards.goal: Stop the panic before the town's moneylenders collapse.

cards.name: Horse thieves
cards.text: Horses are disappearing from the stables of {place}, a few each night.
cards.dm: {lead} is selling them to a dealer who sells them back in the next town.
cards.goal: Catch the horse thieves.

cards.name: A black market in essences
cards.text: Essences are being sold in {place} without the Magic Society's licence, some of them strange and dangerous.
cards.dm: {lead} is selling essences taken from dead adventurers, and some carry the curse of how they died.
cards.goal: Shut down the black market.

cards.name: The pack grows bold
cards.text: {trouble} near {place} has grown bolder, attacking travellers in daylight.
cards.dm: The pack is led by a creature stronger than the rest: {monster}.
cards.goal: Hunt down the pack's leader.
scenes: Talk to survivors and track the pack.
An ambush at dusk on a lonely road.
Find the lair and kill the leader. The pack scatters without it.

cards.name: A lair is found
cards.text: A shepherd from {place} found a monster lair in the hills: bones, and something big sleeping.
cards.dm: It is {monster}, and it has young.
cards.goal: Clear the lair.

cards.name: A migration
cards.text: Herds of monsters are moving across the land near {place}, driven by something behind them.
cards.dm: Something has woken in the deep places and is driving every creature before it.
cards.goal: Protect {place} from the migration, and find what is driving it.

trouble.name: Monster migration
trouble.summary: Herds of monsters are crossing the farmland, trampling everything.
trouble.effect: Expect stampedes and hungry predators following the herds.

cards.name: A Silver-rank sighting
cards.text: Hunters near {place} swear they saw a Silver-rank monster in the woods. The local Society branch has nobody strong enough.
cards.dm: It is real: {monster}, drawn by a surge building elsewhere.
cards.goal: Drive it off, kill it, or bring in someone who can.

cards.name: Livestock slaughtered
cards.text: Something is killing livestock around {place}, a few beasts each night, with strange wounds.
cards.dm: It's a small spawn that has learned to hide, and a farmer's child is feeding it.
cards.goal: Find and deal with the killer.

cards.name: The road is dangerous
cards.text: Travellers on the road near {place} are being attacked by {monster}.
cards.dm: The attacks always happen near the same bridge, where something is nesting under the arches.
cards.goal: Make the road safe.

cards.name: Something in the river
cards.text: Fishing boats near {place} have been capsized, and a fisherman dragged under.
cards.dm: A river beast has moved in, and {lead} has been feeding it to keep their rivals off the water.
cards.goal: Kill the beast, and expose who has been feeding it.

cards.name: A nest in the drains
cards.text: Children in {place} talk of eyes in the drains, and pets have been vanishing.
cards.dm: A nest of giant vermin has grown under the old town, with a brood mother at its heart.
cards.goal: Clear the nest.

cards.name: A tamed monster
cards.text: {lead} has been seen in {place} with a monster on a leash, and the town is terrified.
cards.dm: The monster is tame, bound by an essence ability, and {lead} wants a licence to keep it.
cards.goal: Decide what happens to the tamer and their beast.

cards.name: A giant spawns
cards.text: Something huge has spawned in the fields near {place}. It hasn't moved yet, but it is growing.
cards.dm: It is {monster}, and the longer it sits, the stronger it gets.
cards.goal: Kill it before it wakes fully.

cards.name: The Society calls for help
cards.text: The Adventure Society branch near {place} has posted more contracts than it can fill: every road has something on it.
cards.dm: Spawns are rising because a surge is building nearby, though the branch won't say so.
cards.goal: Take contracts, and find out why there are so many.

cards.name: A great hunt
cards.text: The lord of {place} is holding a great hunt for {monster}, and hiring adventurers to keep the nobles safe.
cards.dm: Someone means to use the hunt to arrange an accident for {lead}.
cards.goal: Keep the nobles alive and bring down the quarry.

cards.name: The dead rise
cards.text: The dead are rising from the graveyard of {place}, and the Church of Death is calling for help.
cards.dm: {lead} is raising them, working for an outlawed church.
cards.goal: Put the dead back to rest, and find who raised them.

cards.name: A flying terror
cards.text: Something with wings is taking cattle and children from {place}.
cards.dm: It is {monster}, nesting on a crag above the town.
cards.goal: Kill the flyer.

cards.name: A monster asks for help
cards.text: A monster that can talk has come to the edge of {place}, asking for the party by name.
cards.dm: It is fleeing something worse, and knows where the worse thing lairs.
cards.goal: Hear it out.

cards.name: Core poachers
cards.text: Poachers are killing monsters near {place} for their cores and leaving the bodies, which draws worse things.
cards.dm: The poachers sell to {lead}, who supplies {faction}.
cards.goal: Stop the poachers.

cards.name: Things from the sea
cards.text: Monsters have crawled out of the sea near {place}, and the fishing fleet won't go out.
cards.dm: An underwater astral space has opened offshore and is spilling out.
cards.goal: Drive the monsters back, and close what let them out.

cards.name: The trouble spreads
cards.text: {trouble} near {place} has spread. Farms are empty, and the next village is preparing to flee.
cards.dm: There is a reason it hasn't been stopped: {lead} is profiting from it.
cards.goal: Put an end to the trouble at last.

cards.name: The trouble's source
cards.text: Hunters have tracked {trouble} near {place} to where it comes from.
cards.dm: The source is a lair hidden in a ruin nobody knew was there.
cards.goal: Strike at the source.

cards.name: An escaped beast
cards.text: A monster has escaped from a collector's menagerie in {place} and is loose in the streets.
cards.dm: {lead} the collector kept it illegally and will pay for silence.
cards.goal: Recapture or kill the beast.

cards.name: Something far above them
cards.text: A thing far beyond anything near {place} has been seen on the horizon, and the sky darkens where it goes.
cards.dm: It is passing through, not hunting. But anyone who gets in its way dies, and a village lies on its path.
cards.goal: Get the village out of the way in time.
scenes: The sighting, and the panic.
Race to the village on its path.
Get everyone out, and survive being close to it.

cards.name: An ambition takes a step
cards.text: {lead} of {place} has announced their plan to stand for the council, and is asking for support.
cards.dm: They need a famous name to back them, and they think the party will do.
cards.goal: Help or hinder their ambition.

cards.name: Revenge
cards.text: {lead} has come to {place} to kill {second}, who they say murdered their parent.
cards.dm: {second} did it, years ago, and has since become a respected priest.
cards.goal: Decide where justice lies.

cards.name: Rivals in love
cards.text: {lead} and {second} are both courting the same person in {place}, and it's getting ugly.
cards.dm: The person they're courting loves someone else entirely.
cards.goal: Settle it, kindly or otherwise.

cards.name: A friend reaches Bronze
cards.text: {lead}, an adventurer from {place}, is close to reaching Bronze rank, and wants one last big hunt.
cards.dm: They are not as ready as they think, and their team is afraid to say so.
cards.goal: Help them rank up, or talk them out of the hunt.

cards.name: A mentor dies
cards.text: {lead}, a well-loved veteran of {place}, has died, and left the party something in their will.
cards.dm: They didn't die naturally, and the will names their killer in a sealed letter.
cards.goal: Find out how they died.

cards.name: An heir is born
cards.text: {lead} of {place} has a new child, and the whole town is celebrating.
cards.dm: The child carries a rare mark that {faction} has been searching for.
cards.goal: Protect the family.

cards.name: A favour called in
cards.text: {lead} sends word from {place}: the party owes them a favour, and they are calling it in.
cards.dm: The favour is something the party won't like.
cards.goal: Repay the favour, or find a way out of it.

cards.name: A runaway
cards.text: {lead}'s teenage child has run away from {place} to become an adventurer.
cards.dm: They have joined a team that uses recruits as bait.
cards.goal: Bring the runaway home, or keep them alive out there.

cards.name: A dream falls apart
cards.text: {lead}'s grand plan in {place} has collapsed, and they have lost everything.
cards.dm: Someone sabotaged them on purpose.
cards.goal: Find who ruined them.

cards.name: A secret comes out
cards.text: Everyone in {place} is talking about {lead}'s secret, which someone has painted on the market wall.
cards.dm: Only three people knew it, and one of them is close to the party.
cards.goal: Find who told.

cards.name: An old enemy returns
cards.text: Someone who has reason to hate the party has been seen in {place}.
cards.dm: {lead} has spent months preparing, and has allies in the town.
cards.goal: Find out what they want before they strike.

cards.name: A deathbed confession
cards.text: Old {lead} of {place} is dying and asks to see the party before the end.
cards.dm: They confess to a crime decades old, and the victim's family still lives in town.
cards.goal: Hear the confession, and decide what to do with it.

cards.name: A forced betrothal
cards.text: {lead} is being made to marry a stranger to pay their family's debts in {place}.
cards.dm: The stranger, {second}, wants out of it just as much.
cards.goal: Help them, or let it be.

cards.name: A lost sibling
cards.text: {lead} asks the party to find their sibling, last seen in {place} years ago.
cards.dm: The sibling is alive, and under a new name, and doesn't want to be found.
cards.goal: Find the lost sibling.

cards.name: The party's fame spreads
cards.text: A bard in {place} has written a song about the party, and it is getting more popular, and less accurate, every day.
cards.dm: {lead} commissioned the song to use the party's name for their own scheme.
cards.goal: Set the record straight, or enjoy the fame.

cards.name: An impostor
cards.text: Someone claiming to be one of the party has been running up debts in {place}.
cards.dm: {lead} is an impostor with a disguise essence, and the debts are to dangerous people.
cards.goal: Catch the impostor.

cards.name: An apprentice asks
cards.text: {lead}, a young person from {place}, begs one of the party to take them as an apprentice.
cards.dm: They are running from something and need a strong protector.
cards.goal: Decide whether to take them on.

cards.name: A friend falls ill
cards.text: {lead} of {place}, a friend to the party, has fallen ill, and the healers can't help.
cards.dm: It's a curse, placed by someone who wants their property.
cards.goal: Find a cure.

cards.name: Gambling debts
cards.text: {lead} has lost far more than they had at a card table in {place}, and the house wants paying.
cards.dm: The game was rigged by a gambling-den owner with an essence that reads luck.
cards.goal: Get the debt cancelled, or win it back.

cards.name: A town mourns
cards.text: {place} is in mourning after {lead} drowned. Their family asks the party to recover the body from the lake.
cards.dm: It wasn't a drowning, and the body isn't in the lake.
cards.goal: Recover the body, and find the truth.

cards.name: A grudge against the party
cards.text: {lead} of {place} has been telling everyone the party ruined their life, and people are listening.
cards.dm: They have a point: something the party did hurt them, without the party knowing.
cards.goal: Make amends, or answer the accusation.

cards.name: An astral space opens
cards.text: An astral space has opened near {place}, and the local Society branch is assigning teams to it.
cards.dm: It is more dangerous than its rank suggests, and the first team to enter hasn't come out.
cards.goal: Enter the astral space and bring the missing team out.

cards.name: An outworlder arrives
cards.text: Someone has appeared near {place} out of nowhere, speaking a strange language and wearing stranger clothes.
cards.dm: {lead} is an outworlder, and {faction} wants them for what they know.
cards.goal: Find the outworlder before {faction} does.

cards.name: A divine sign
cards.text: A statue of the {church}'s god in {place} has begun to weep, and pilgrims are flooding in.
cards.dm: It is a real sign: the god wants something done, and it has to do with the party.
cards.goal: Find out what the god wants.

cards.name: An avatar walks
cards.text: People in {place} say a god's avatar has been walking among them, asking questions.
cards.dm: It is true. The avatar is searching for someone who has offended its god, and it may not care who gets hurt.
cards.goal: Survive the avatar's attention, and help it or hinder it.
scenes: Strange things in town: miracles, and people too frightened to speak.
Meet the avatar, who wants something.
Find who it is looking for, before it loses patience.

cards.name: A wild essence
cards.text: A child in {place} has absorbed an essence by accident, and strange things are happening around them.
cards.dm: The essence is a rare one, and {faction} wants it.
cards.goal: Protect the child, and teach them to control it.

cards.name: The magic fades
cards.text: In a ring around {place}, magic has stopped working. Essence abilities fail, and the healers' powers are gone.
cards.dm: A device buried by {lead} is drawing the magic into itself, and it is close to bursting.
cards.goal: Find the cause before it bursts.

cards.name: A ritual gone wrong
cards.text: A Magic Society ritual in {place} went wrong, and a building is now somewhere else.
cards.dm: The building and the scholars inside are in a pocket astral space, and the way in is closing.
cards.goal: Get the scholars back before the way closes.

cards.name: A cursed treasure
cards.text: {lead} of {place} found a treasure and has been acting strangely since.
cards.dm: The treasure is cursed, and is making them into something else.
cards.goal: Break the curse.

cards.name: The stars are wrong
cards.text: Astrologers in {place} say the stars have moved. Dogs howl all night.
cards.dm: An astral king is passing close to the world, and its attention is falling on {place}.
cards.goal: Find out what the stars mean, and what is coming.

cards.name: A strange stone
cards.text: A merchant in {place} is selling an awakening stone no one can identify.
cards.dm: It's a fake, and {lead} has sold dozens.
cards.goal: Find out what the stone really is.

cards.name: The circle misfires
cards.text: The teleport circle at {place} misfired, and three travellers came out wrong.
cards.dm: Someone tampered with the circle to send a passenger elsewhere, and three innocents were caught in it.
cards.goal: Fix the circle and find out who tampered with it.

cards.name: Lights in the marsh
cards.text: Lights have been seen moving in the marsh near {place}, and those who follow them don't come back.
cards.dm: The lights are spirits leading people to a drowned temple.
cards.goal: Follow the lights safely.

cards.name: A prophecy
cards.text: A seer in {place} has made a prophecy about the party, and the whole town has heard it.
cards.dm: The seer, {lead}, is a fraud, but the prophecy is true anyway.
cards.goal: Find out what the prophecy means.

cards.name: A monster with essences
cards.text: A monster near {place} is using essence powers, which monsters shouldn't have.
cards.dm: It absorbed the essences of an adventurer it killed: {lead}.
cards.goal: Hunt it down.

cards.name: A rift
cards.text: A rift has torn open in the sky above {place}, and things are coming through.
cards.dm: The rift was opened by a cult in an old ruin, and they mean to widen it.
cards.goal: Close the rift.

trouble.name: A rift in the sky
trouble.summary: A tear in the sky lets strange creatures through.
trouble.effect: Creatures from beyond appear without warning.

cards.name: A god's trial
cards.text: The {church} in {place} says its god has set a trial for anyone worthy, and the prize is a divine essence.
cards.dm: The trial is real, and dangerous, and one candidate, {lead}, is cheating.
cards.goal: Take the trial, or stop the cheat.

cards.name: An astral space collapses
cards.text: An astral space near {place} is collapsing, and the team inside is trapped.
cards.dm: The collapse will spill its creatures into the world when it ends.
cards.goal: Get the team out, and be ready for what spills out.

cards.name: Magic runs rich
cards.text: The magic around {place} is running rich, and crafters are making things they never could before.
cards.dm: {lead} is using the surge to make something dangerous.
cards.goal: Find out what they're making.

cards.name: More outworlders
cards.text: More outworlders have arrived near {place}, and they claim to know each other.
cards.dm: They are part of a group sent by something from their world, and one of them, {lead}, is not what they seem.
cards.goal: Find out why they have come.

cards.name: A blessing
cards.text: {place} has been blessed by the {church}: harvests are good and people are healthy.
cards.dm: The blessing has a price, and the bill is about to come due.
cards.goal: Find out what the price is.

cards.name: A cursed town
cards.text: Since {festival}, nobody in {place} can sleep. They are wearing down, and tempers are fraying.
cards.dm: The town was cursed at the festival by {lead}, who was turned away at the gate.
cards.goal: Lift the curse before the town tears itself apart.

cards.name: A house strikes back
cards.text: Hired blades have been asking around {place} about the party: where they sleep, and who they drink with.
cards.dm: {faction} has not forgiven the party, and has hired {lead} to teach them a lesson.
cards.goal: Survive the ambush, and find out who paid for it.
scenes: Notice the questions being asked about you.
The ambush, at the worst possible moment.
Follow the money back to {faction}, and decide how to answer.

cards.name: A whispering campaign
cards.text: Stories about the party are spreading in {place}: that they rob the dead, and take bribes.
cards.dm: {faction} is paying {lead} to spread them, to ruin the party's name.
cards.goal: Clear the party's name.

cards.name: A rigged contract
cards.text: A contract in {place} pays far too well for the work it asks.
cards.dm: It is bait, set by {faction} to send the party somewhere they won't come back from.
cards.goal: Take the contract, or turn the trap on its makers.

cards.name: A patron's offer
cards.text: {faction} sends word to the party in {place}: they have work, and they pay well.
cards.dm: The job is honest, but it will put the party on the wrong side of {faction}'s rivals.
cards.goal: Hear the offer.

cards.name: A favour returned
cards.text: {faction} remembers what the party did for them, and offers a favour in {place}.
cards.dm: The favour is real, though it comes with an expectation.
cards.goal: Decide what to ask for.
cards.reward: A favour from {faction}: a safe house, an introduction, or a door opened

cards.name: A feast in their honour
cards.text: {place} is holding a feast in the party's honour, and the whole town is coming.
cards.dm: Someone at the feast, {lead}, has a grievance with one of the party and means to air it in public.
cards.goal: Attend the feast.
cards.reward: Free room and board in {place} for a season

cards.name: A plea for help
cards.text: The people of {place} trust the party, and come to them first when {lead} goes missing.
cards.dm: {lead} went looking for the party's help and was taken on the way.
cards.goal: Find {lead}.

cards.name: Doors close
cards.text: Innkeepers in {place} are turning the party away, and the market stalls have no stock for them.
cards.dm: {lead}, who was hurt by something the party did, is behind the cold shoulder.
cards.goal: Win back {place}, or find somewhere else to stay.

cast.label: who turned the town against them

cards.name: A mob
cards.text: A crowd has gathered outside where the party is staying in {place}, and it is turning ugly.
cards.dm: {lead} has stirred them up with a story that is half true.
cards.goal: Get out of {place} without bloodshed, or face the crowd.

cards.name: A rival team
cards.text: A rival team of adventurers, led by {lead}, has arrived in {place}, and they want everything the party has.
cards.dm: {lead} is jealous of the party's name and will take their contracts by fair means or foul.
cards.goal: Deal with the rivals.

cards.name: A challenger
cards.text: A young fighter, {lead}, has come to {place} to challenge one of the party to a duel and make their own name.
cards.dm: {lead} is better than they look, and someone is betting heavily on them.
cards.goal: Accept the challenge, or talk them out of it.

cards.name: A summons
cards.text: The party's name has reached the powerful. A messenger in {place} brings a summons from the ruler's court.
cards.dm: The court wants the party for a task no one else will touch, and refusing would be unwise.
cards.goal: Answer the summons.

cards.name: Escorts for the {goods}
cards.text: {place} is short of {goods}, and the only caravan bringing more needs guards through dangerous country.
cards.dm: {lead}, who owns the caravan, has also promised half of it to a hoarder in {place}.
cards.goal: Bring the caravan in safely.
scenes: Meet the caravan and its nervous drivers.
The road, and what waits on it.
Arrive in {place}, and find out who the {goods} is really for.

cards.name: A hoarder
cards.text: With {goods} short in {place}, someone is buying up what's left and selling it at five times the price.
cards.dm: {lead} is the hoarder, and the town watch has been paid to look away.
cards.goal: Find the hoard, and decide what to do with it.

cards.name: Smuggled {goods}
cards.text: Smugglers are bringing {goods} into {place}, and nobody is asking questions while the shortage lasts.
cards.dm: {lead}'s smugglers are carrying something else under the {goods}.
cards.goal: Look into the smugglers.
